title: MULTI-DIMENSIONAL INSIGHTS: BENCHMARKING REAL-WORLD PERSONALIZATION IN LARGE MULTIMODAL MODELS
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark (MDI) for evaluating personalization in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) across six real-world domains such as housework, education, and sports. It explicitly mentions avoiding classifications based on religious beliefs in favor of more objective metrics like age group, and it does not include any specific evaluation or discussion of faith, morals, or ethics.
